en: A vintage illustrated postcard depicting a uniformed mailman holding a letter in his right hand and resting his left hand on what appears to be a mailbag or parcel. He wears a dark cap and coat with brass buttons. The background is a plain light color. The word 'Tervehdys' is printed in red in the upper right, and the word 'Hämeenlinnasta' appears in white on the dark mailbag across the lower center.
